dialogue.text: Hey! Thank you so much for letting me stay. That was some game as an introduction. I’m Astrid Iverson! I’m on vacation from Denmark, and it’s just my luck to be stuck haha.
That’s a nice thought. Say, I was completely lost. To be honest, I am still really lost…
Haha, atleast I’m not alone. Could you do me a favor?
I want to be prepared. Where I’m from, we don’t have the ground shake this violently. Do you think you could help me write a plan?
I would ask around too, but I’m a little nervous to talk to everyone. I don't exactly blend in.
You’re a life saver! Thank you again, I’ll be waiting for you here.
